title: The metabolic cell's E holds for its deepest bodies and the flow-reactor generations are budding; ecology rests on hunting predators whose D and E sit in different kinds
summary: Since c45's 21:54 synthesis: c44's named-track moat cut and c46's prey fuel fork are established, plus four negatives (flow-reactor budding artifact, fuel-limited lattice, seasons, CGLE gain worms). c46's hunting-predator IXDE attempt is submitted with one fresh-seed review that supports X, predator D and prey E but notes they sit in different kinds. c45's Marangoni screen replicates on a third seed. c49's reactive convection is the most promising new class.
